title: Landsat Collection 2 Level-2 Science Products (Surface Reflectance and Surface Temperature)
description: Scene-based, atmospherically corrected surface reflectance and surface temperature products at 30 m generated by USGS EROS from Landsat 4–5 TM, Landsat 7 ETM+ and Landsat 8–9 OLI/TIRS Collection 2 Level-1 data. Products are distributed as Cloud Optimized GeoTIFFs with MTL/XML metadata.
purpose: The longest consistent 30 m optical record available for Algeria (from the 1980s), suitable for long-term land-cover, cropland, irrigation and surface-water change analysis and as a complement to Sentinel-2 since 2015.

license_notes: USGS states that USGS-authored data are in the U.S. public domain and suggests the credit 'U.S. Geological Survey'. The USGS entry in the AWS Open Data Registry adds: 'There are no restrictions on Landsat data downloaded from the USGS; it can be used or redistributed as desired', with a request to include a statement of the data source.

spatial_extent.description: Worldwide scene-based products. Algeria is covered by many scenes; users must select scenes or use cloud/STAC access to subset Algeria.

temporal_extent.description: Landsat 4 TM July 1982–December 1993; Landsat 5 TM March 1984–May 2012; Landsat 7 ETM+ July 1999 to present; Landsat 8 OLI/TIRS April 2013 to present; Landsat 9 OLI/TIRS 31 January 2022 to present (per USGS DOI landing pages). Actual archive coverage over Algeria varies by period and sensor.

crs: UTM / WGS 84, zone of each scene (e.g. EPSG:32631, UTM zone 31N, for a scene over Algiers); Algeria spans UTM zones 29N–32N

variables.name: Surface reflectance (SR_B*)
variables.description: Unsigned 16-bit; scale factor 0.0000275, offset -0.2; fill value 0; valid range 1–65455.

variables.name: Surface temperature (ST_B*)
variables.description: Unsigned 16-bit; scale factor 0.00341802, offset 149.0; fill value 0; valid range 1–65535.

processing: Surface reflectance for Landsat 8–9 OLI uses the LaSRC algorithm (version 1.5.0); Landsat 4–5 TM and Landsat 7 ETM+ use LEDAPS (version 3.4.0). Surface temperature for Landsat 4–9 uses an algorithm (version 1.3.0) developed with RIT and NASA JPL, with GEOS-5 FP-IT (2000–present) and MERRA-2 (1982–1999) atmospheric inputs. Level-2 products are typically available 24–72 hours after a scene reaches Tier 1 or Tier 2.
limitations: Surface temperature cannot be generated when required auxiliary data are missing.
USGS advises that OLI bands 1 (coastal aerosol) and 2 (blue) should not be used for analysis in the Level-2 product because they are used in aerosol inversion.
Landsat 7 ETM+ was moved to a lower orbit (about 8 km lower); scenes acquired 5 May 2022–19 January 2024 were collected at this lower altitude.
Reflectance and temperature values are stored as scaled integers and must be rescaled with the published scale factor and offset before use.
Cloud-hosted bucket on AWS is requester-pays (users pay egress).

algeria_notes: Landsat gives Algeria a 30 m record back to the 1980s, which is the main way to document the expansion of centre-pivot irrigation and new agricultural perimeters in the Sahara and changes in the northern cereal belt over decades. Older TM coverage over Algeria may be uneven, and the thermal-based surface temperature product is useful for irrigated-field and oasis heat contrasts in the south.

verification.notes: Three DOIs exist (one per sensor family); the record uses the Landsat 8-9 DOI as primary and lists Landsat 7 and 4-5 in references. USGS citations were revised in 2024 without changing DOI or version. temporal_extent.start uses day 01 because USGS gives only the month (July 1982). usgs.gov pages returned HTTP 403 to command-line requests (bot protection) but were read successfully via a browser-style fetch; DOIs resolve to these pages. EarthExplorer, AWS registry and LandsatLook STAC returned HTTP 200. CRS confirmed by AEO from the USGS STAC item LC09_L2SP_196035_20261115 (proj:epsg 32631).
